explanation: Can the unit square be covered by rectangles of sizes 1/(n+1) × 1/(n+2), allowing rigid motions? This is the MO / Concrete Mathematics research exercise (Leo Moser's problem), and it remains open; recent work such as the Sept 2026 tail-packing preprint does not settle the full sequence. Since the areas sum to 1, any such cover is in particular a measure-theoretic packing. The statement is faithful and open.
